channel.title: Frontion News
channel.description: Breaking geopolitics headlines from Tier 1 sources

item.title: 🇺🇸🇮🇷 US pauses Iran strikes for third night as military advisors warn of dwindling munitions
item.description: The US has halted attacks on Iran for a third consecutive night after top military officials advised Trump the bombing campaign had reached its limits. Iran also paused retaliatory operations. Oil prices fell on the pause, and diplomatic talks over the Strait of Hormuz continue.

item.title: 🇦🇷🇧🇷 Argentina Milei calls Brazil Lula a thief and convict at Bolsonaro rally, Brazil recalls ambassador
item.description: Argentina president Javier Milei insulted Brazilian president Lula da Silva at a campaign rally for Flavio Bolsonaro in Sao Paulo, calling him a thief and convict. Brazil recalled its ambassador in response, escalating a diplomatic crisis between the two largest South American economies.

item.title: 🇨🇳💻 Chinese chipmaker CXMT shares surge 470% in massive Shanghai IPO debut
item.description: CXMT, China largest memory chipmaker, saw its shares soar as much as 472% in mainland China biggest IPO in years, raising at least 8.6 billion. The company market cap reached about 3.3 trillion yuan, making it the most valuable firm on a mainland Chinese exchange.

item.title: 🇺🇦🇷🇺 Ukraine and US discuss air ceasefire proposal ahead of Trump-Zelenskyy meeting
item.description: Ukrainian and US officials have discussed offering Russia an air ceasefire proposal ahead of a Trump-Zelenskyy meeting in Washington on Tuesday. The Kremlin said it was premature to comment. Meanwhile, Russia launched seven ballistic missiles and 136 drones at Ukraine overnight.

item.title: 🇷🇺🇺🇦 Russia cancels St. Petersburg Navy Day parade for second year amid Ukrainian drone threat
item.description: Russia has canceled its annual Navy Day parade in St. Petersburg for the second consecutive year, as Ukraine's deep-strike drone capabilities put even heavily defended Russian cities at risk.

item.title: 🇺🇦🛢️ Civilian grain ship sinks in Black Sea after Russian missile strike
item.description: A civilian cargo ship sank near Odesa after being struck by Russian missiles on July 19 while transporting grain, highlighting the ongoing threat to food shipping routes.

item.title: 🇩🇪🛢️ Germany pulls back two navy ships from Strait of Hormuz as Iran war drags on
item.description: German defense leaders have pulled back two navy ships that were earmarked for a post-war mission in the Strait of Hormuz, citing little hope for a near-term resolution of the Iran conflict.

item.title: 🇺🇸🇨🇳🇮🇷 Trump's Iran strikes hit US strategy to contain China via Chabahar port
item.description: US air strikes on Iran have damaged the Indian-backed port of Chabahar, long seen as a counterweight to China's Belt and Road influence, undermining Washington's own containment strategy in the region.

item.title: 🇨🇳🇪🇺 China blacklists Polish university in retaliation for EU dual-use export controls
item.description: China has placed Wroclaw University of Science and Technology on its export control blacklist alongside defense firms, retaliating against the latest round of EU sanctions targeting dual-use technology.

item.title: 🇮🇺🇦🇦 Iran Warns Ukraine of Retaliation After Deadly Caspian Sea Strike
item.description: Iran Foreign Minister Araghchi said a Ukrainian attack on an Iranian commercial vessel in the Caspian Sea that killed one sailor cannot go unanswered, accusing Israel of provoking the strike. Iran summoned Ukraine’s charge d’affaires and a senior lawmaker warned Kyiv could face retaliation.

item.title: 🇨🇣💻 Chinese Chipmaker CXMT Surges 470% on Debut, Becomes Mainland Most Valuable Listed Firm
item.description: ChangXin Memory Technologies shares soared more than 470% in their Shanghai Star Market debut, pushing CXMT market valuation to around 3.3 trillion yuan ($487bn) and making it the most valuable listed company in mainland China. The spectacular IPO comes despite a global tech selloff and highlights Chinese investor appetite for homegrown chipmakers.

item.title: 🇺🇸⚖️ Trump Border Czar Probes Vetting Failures After Deadly ICE Shooting in Maine
item.description: Trump border czar Tom Homan said the vetting of an ICE officer involved in the deadly shooting of a Colombian native in Maine is under internal review, after the officer’s relatives revealed a history of mental health struggles and violent behaviour. Homan acknowledged the officer may never have passed proper vetting.

item.title: 🇸🇦🇾🇪🛢 Saudi Arabia and Houthis Trade Fire as US Fires on Tanker in Hormuz Strait
item.description: Iran-backed Houthis claimed a missile attack on the Saudi city of Jizan in retaliation for Saudi airstrikes on Hodeida. Meanwhile, the US military said it fired on and disabled a tanker in the Gulf of Oman attempting to evade the American blockade on Iranian ports. No overnight US or Iran strikes were reported for the first time in two weeks.

item.title: 🇫🇷🔥 Wildfires Force 300,000+ to Flee as Flames Threaten Bordeaux
item.description: Massive wildfires in southwest France have forced over 300,000 people to evacuate across France and Spain, with fires creeping toward the city of Bordeaux. French President Macron called an emergency cabinet meeting as another heatwave approaches.

item.title: 🇷🇴⚔️ Romania Shoots Down Third Russian Drone in Three Days, Summons Ambassador
item.description: Romania shot down a third Russian drone in as many days, prompting Bucharest to summon Russia's ambassador. The repeated airspace violations raise concerns about the Russia-Ukraine war spilling over into NATO territory.

item.title: 🇮🇱🇸🇾 Israel Launches Military Incursion Into Syria as UN Condemns Violations
item.description: Israeli forces advanced into southwestern Syrian villages, setting up a checkpoint and dropping leaflets warning residents. UN Secretary-General Guterres condemned the violations of Syria's sovereignty during a visit to the country.

item.title: 🇺🇸🇮🇷 Trump Paused Iran Attacks to Give Diplomacy Space, Says US Ambassador
item.description: The US paused attacks on Iran for a second consecutive night to allow diplomatic talks space, according to UN Ambassador Mike Waltz. Iran also halted retaliatory attacks. Oil prices hit $100/barrel as the conflict nears its fifth month.

item.title: 🇨🇳🌀 Typhoon Noul — Strongest to Hit China This Year — Lashes Hong Kong
item.description: Typhoon Noul made landfall in southern China, becoming the strongest typhoon to hit the country in 2026 so far. Hong Kong airport cancelled around 360 flights as scaffolding collapsed in powerful winds. No injuries reported.

item.title: 🇺🇦 Zelensky struggles to contain political crisis after sacking defence minister Fedorov
item.description: President Zelensky faces ongoing protests after removing popular defence minister Mykhailo Fedorov, who rejected alternative posts and hinted at presidential ambitions. The appointment of Maj Gen Drapatyi as commander-in-chief has been welcomed, but Fedorov supporters continue daily street demonstrations demanding his reinstatement.

item.title: 🇺🇦 Russia kills 10 in ballistic missile strike on drone exhibition near Kyiv
item.description: Russian forces fired three ballistic missiles at a drone technology exhibition near Kyiv, killing at least 10 people and wounding around 100. The targeted event was attended by prominent members of Ukraine defence industry, raising questions about operational security.

item.title: 🇵🇸 Israel approves international stabilisation force for Gaza under Trump peace plan
item.description: Israel security cabinet approved the entry of an International Stabilisation Force into Gaza, part of Trump 20-point peace plan. The force will include 200 personnel from friendly countries and operate in coordination with the Israeli military, with Israel retaining authority over which nations can participate.

item.title: 🇭🇳 Former Honduran President Hernández returns home after Trump pardon, faces domestic charges
item.description: Juan Orlando Hernández, convicted in the US for drug trafficking and sentenced to 45 years, returned to Honduras after Trump pardoned him claiming the trial was a Biden-era setup. He now faces fraud and money-laundering charges in Honduras, though activists fear the prosecution will be a sham.

item.title: 🇩🇪 Berlin Pride attack suspect shot and killed by German police
item.description: Abdul Ballout, a 21-year-old German-Lebanese citizen suspected of driving a van into a Pride crowd in Berlin, was shot and killed by police after rushing at officers with a knife. Germany has raised its threat level following the attack that killed one woman and injured 29.

item.title: 🇬🇧🇺🇦 UK PM Burnham pledges unwavering Ukraine support, shares electronic warfare tech
item.description: New UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham made Zelenskyy his first international visitor, announcing the sharing of Britain's "Stone Cloak" drone-jamming technology IP with Ukraine for domestic production, alongside new cruise missile development plans.

item.title: 🇺🇸🇮🇷 US-Iran fighting paused but both sides face uncertain off-ramp
item.description: After nearly two weeks of daily strikes, the US has paused bombing Iran for two nights. Diplomatic efforts continue over the Strait of Hormuz, but Netanyahu's upcoming White House visit and dwindling munitions concerns add uncertainty to whether the pause becomes lasting peace.
